title: Aircraft & Trailer Lavatory Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8224  AFSC OL H PZIM
description_text: Seeking information from interested Contractors for market research purposes to support a potential need for the following requirement: Contractor shall provide all management, tools, supplies, equipment, and labor necessary to flush, empty, clean, and drain incoming C-130 aircraft and possible 309 AMXG trailer break-room toilets, dispose of waste materials, and prepare the toilet systems, in accordance with the procedures outlined in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). Contractor must be able to respond within 24 hours of a standard call request and within 2 hours for emergency call requests. This work will be done for the 309th Aircraft Maintenance Group at Hill AFB. See the attached sources sought document for full description and response requirements. If you experience issues opening the attached PDF, please reach out to the point of contacts listed below.
